notes.title: Game Update: Swamp Gnomes
notes.content:
[p]Hello there![/p][p]September has arrived, the leaves are starting to fall, and with it comes some exciting news: two little houses in Moss Glade are now open![/p][h3][b]The Swamp Gnomes[/b], long-time residents of the village, have returned from their summer vacation. [/h3][p]You can now find them hidden around Moss Glade or busy in their tiny homes - good luck spotting them! 🍄🐸[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog game version 1.2.2:[/h3][p][/p][p][b]🌿 New content in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]57 Swamp Gnomes[/b] to discover[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two new tiny homes[/b]: Boletus House & Pollen House[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 brand-new achievements[/b] to unlock
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🛠️ What’s improved:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Hints now work for secrets[/b] - After finding all frogs, toads, and gnomes, hints will now help you uncover hidden secrets too.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings improvements[/b] - All gameplay-related options are now visible in the settings screen, including info about the day/night cycle and optional color mode. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Map improvements[/b] - Each location now displays exactly what’s still missing, making it easier to track your progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Uncle Froger’s quest screen updated[/b] - We’ve clarified what needs to be found to complete the game, and added there a list of secret hints.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Menu updated[/b] - Uncle Froger now has a “!” icon to better highlight the main quest. Website and Discord links are now available directly from the main screen![/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Yes! We make our own Discord server, [/b]to make your communication even better. We will be showing development progress there, some art stuff and more, so hop in![/h3][p][/p][p][b]Thank you also for over 50 reviews.[/b] We’re so happy to see you’re enjoying the game! 💚[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Have a good time again in Moss Glade, and see you soon,[/p][p]Dorota & Aleksander[/p][p][b]₍𝄐⩌𝄐₎[/b][/p]

notes.title: Update in the Making & New Game Announcement!
notes.content: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been just over a month since [b]Find My Frogs[/b] was released, and we’re so excited by all the wonderful reviews and the love you've shown the game so far. Thank you so much! 💚[/p][p][/p][p]We're currently working on a new update for [b]Find My Frogs[/b], which will include various improvements based on your feedback plus brand-new locations and characters to discover. [/p][p][/p][h3]Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in the next update:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482023/6f023c134151621952e9b19a34ba01105f670681.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Who can live here...?[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Alongside the update, we’re also working on a [b]new game[/b] set in the world of Moss Glade.[/p][p][/p][h3]We’re happy to announce [b]Find My Frogs: Branches[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3948760/Find_My_Frogs_Branches/"][/dynamiclink]This time, you’ll be searching for adorable frogs and toads high up in the ancient tree crown, with new quests from Uncle Froger. Want to know more? Visit [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3948760/Find_My_Frogs_Branches/"]Find My Frogs: Branches[/url] on Steam and wishlist it so you don’t miss any updates! 🐸[/p][p][/p][p][b]Finally, a small favor:[/b] If you have a minute, please consider leaving a Steam review for [b]Find My Frogs[/b]! We’re just 6 away from 50, and hitting that milestone helps Steam show our game to more people. For a tiny studio like ours, it makes a big difference.💚[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being here with us and speak to you soon,[/p][p]Dorota & Aleksander[/p][p][b]₍𝄐⩌𝄐₎[/b][/p]

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content: [h3][b]Thank you[/b] so much for all the lovely reviews, comments, and kind words!✨[/h3][p]We also want to give a huge shout out and a hug to everyone who left a [b]review[/b] on our Steam, It help us a lot! 🐸[/p][p][/p][p]We’re currently working on a small surprise for you, along with some technical improvements. [/p][p]More updates are on the way![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any additional feedback or suggestions, feel free to share them below.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for being here with us,[/p][p]Dorota & Aleksander[/p][p]₍𝄐⩌𝄐₎[/p]

notes.title: Find My Frogs is out now!
notes.content:
[h3]We're incredibly happy to finally share the game with you:[/h3][h3][b]✨Find My Frogs[/b] in now avaliable!✨[/h3][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see how you enjoy your time in Moss Glade.🐸[/p][p][/p][p][b]To celebrate the launch[/b], we've added a little gift: a [b]free DLC with coloring pages[/b] featuring characters and scenes from the game:[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897450/Find_My_Frogs__Paper/"][/dynamiclink] A cozy way to relax even away from the screen 💚[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for being here with us,[/p][p]Dorota & Aleksander[/p][p]₍𝄐⩌𝄐₎[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hello there![/p][p]The frogs are ready and the village is waiting to be explored![/p][p]We’re so excited to announce that [b]Find My Frogs[/b] launches on [b]July 23rd[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we’ve put together a brand-new trailer made entirely from actual gameplay, and it’s already live on Steam! [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, and don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t yet:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130800/Find_My_Frogs/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for being here with us,[/p][p]Dorota & Aleksander[/p][p]₍𝄐⩌𝄐₎[/p]
